name: Yakan Shinryou Karte 2 ~Nurse Tokubetsu Choukyou~
original_name: 夜姦診療 カルテ2～ナース特別調教～
source:
Several months have passed since the protagonist, Takamine Kazuki, started working at Kisaragi Clinic.

His already scandalous relationship with Kuribayashi Misao or Uesugi Rina (depending on your playthrough) has deepened, and now, with the addition of the super busty nurse Kurashiki Fumie, the lewd games between the protagonist and the nurses are escalating.


[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ007405.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公高峰一树进入如月诊所工作已有数月。

他与栗林美纱绪或上杉理奈之间原本就颇为出格的关系，已随着不同路线而进一步加深；而巨乳护士仓敷史江的加入，更使主人公与护士们之间淫靡的游戏愈演愈烈。
